news.title: Elias Lindholm authors first four-goal game of career in Bruins' 7-5 victory
news.ruTitle: Elias Lindholm authors first four-goal game of career in Bruins' 7-5 victory
news.description: Veteran forward Elias Lindholm authored the first four-goal game of his NHL career, carrying the Bruins past the Washington Capitals 7-5 on Saturday, an effort in which Boston scored three times in the opening nine minutes of the second period.

news.title: Stutzle's 2 goals in the 3rd period help power the Senators to a 4-2 win over the Kings
news.ruTitle: Stutzle's 2 goals in the 3rd period help power the Senators to a 4-2 win over the Kings
news.description: — Tim Stutzle had a three-point game that included a pair of goals in the third period, leading the Ottawa Senators to a 4-2 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night.

news.title: Blue Jackets stun Maple Leafs late and extend Toronto's winless streak to nine
news.ruTitle: Blue Jackets stun Maple Leafs late and extend Toronto's winless streak to nine
news.description: — Zach Werenski scored with 3:28 left in regulation as the Columbus Blue Jackets battled back late to top Toronto 4-3 on Saturday night and extend the Maple Leafs’ winless streak to nine games.
